summary: Adds customParams field to DHDescriptor, threads it through IPC (proxy/stub Read/WriteDescriptors), EnableTask, ComponentManager::Enable, ComponentEnable::Enable, and adds ConfigDistributedHardware call before RegisterDistributedHardware when customParams is non-empty. Also removes udid parameter from CheckDemandStart/GetRemoteVerInfo and adds cloud sync fallback (ActiveSyncMetaData/CloudSyncData) in online_task. Key risks: (1) IPC wire-format change adds customParams string to DHDescriptor serialization — breaks ABI compatibility with older clients; (2) ERR_DH_FWK_COMPONENT_CONFIG_FAILED (-10307) is within ComponentManager range but overlaps the common errno range pattern where -10007 is already used for UNREGISTER_FAILED; (3) ActiveSyncMetaData in online_task introduces a 13-second delayed task on the event handler that calls ActiveCloudSyncData if no meta data found, which may fire after the online task has already completed.
